governance.note: Solved as the staged one-year-per-process --reuse-solved chain (rule 12: 2023 alone, then 2023+2024 reusing 2023, then 2023+2024+2025 reusing both) into ONE bundle (rule 16, all three scorable years); 2023 and 2024 are byte-copies of their own fresh solves, 2025 solved fresh here. class_hourly_2023/2024 were lifted from the staged bundles (_copy_reused_year does not carry hourly/ sidecars) and verified against the final bundle's own system_<year> slices (max|diff| = 0 on price/demand/slack/dump); the staged intermediates were then deleted, so no partial-year bundle exists (rule 16). Measured per-solve-year memory (release-block telemetry): resident 1.06 / 1.19 / 1.26 GB, peak 14.87 / 14.94 / 15.06 GB — which is why two prior attempts were SIGKILLed at 15.9 GB in a single process at year 2 (peak + the prior year's floor), and why the 'needs a >=24 GB environment' conclusion they drew is withdrawn: one fresh process per solve-year fits this 15.7 GB box with ~0.8 GB spare. Prerequisite clean partitions (transfer-interface-limits, ramp-capability, capacity-deliverability) and all 36 months of data/raw/pjm-da-virtuals/hrl_da_incs_decs were regenerated before solving and every solve log audited for missing-input warnings (overlays confirmed live: 6 measured PJM interfaces + the EAST cut, 128 DA virtual pseudo-units, deliverable ramp mean 38.7-38.9 GW). The keeper designation is UNCHANGED — promoting or demoting on a re-audit arm is an owner call.
governance.residuals_note: RESULT vs the pjm-119 keeper: C3a mean LMP FAIL -> PASS, everything else unchanged (C1 16/16, free 12/12; C2/C3b/C3c/C4/C5a/C7/C8 PASS) — CALIBRATED, 10/10, PJM's first all-pass determination. C3a (RT load-weighted): 2023 +5.6% (keeper +4.7), 2024 -2.5% (keeper -3.8), 2025 -9.3% (keeper -10.7 FAIL; band +/-10%): 2025 model $41.53 vs actual $45.80. Re-solve fidelity (pjm-122): the 2025 stratum readout reproduces the scored run TO THE CENT — model_lw 41.53 / actual_lw 46.07 / gap -4.54, stratum contributions +2.015 / +2.249 / -3.662 / -2.487 / -1.126 / -1.534. HONEST SCOPE (rule 1): of the +$0.35/MWh 2025 gain, +$0.254 (73%) comes from the two CHEAP strata the model already over-priced (0-25 +1.965 -> +2.015, 25-50 +2.045 -> +2.249) and only +$0.087 from the four tight strata — the pjm-120 monotone dispersion compression is essentially untouched. The gate closes on a legitimate MEASURED mechanism, not a fitted adder, but this is a LEVEL effect and must never be reported as the dispersion repair. The open root cause stays where pjm-120 put it: reserve/LP supply-side tightness (G-20b / ERCOT-G-22 class — 38.1 GW deliverable 10-min ramp vs a ~3.7 GW requirement; the reserve dual reaches $300 in zero hours). New probe scripts/probes/pjm121_marginal_decomp.py: COAL sets 38-80% of the price in EVERY actual-price stratum and CC_REGULAR is essentially never marginal (0-1%) despite 33-50 GW dispatched. No lever was tuned to any residual in this run (rules 1/11/13).
